using-factory-tui.text: factory-tui is only as clear as your tmux names.
The layout on this page is what the current binary understands, not a final factory design.

bind-and-keys.text: Bind it as a tmux popup. F1 or prefix S opens it.
j and k move, Enter jumps, q quits, r refreshes.

what-to-put-where.text: Sessions are bags of related work. Windows are the seats you want to find.
Zero-machine and zero-projects are infrastructure. Product work lives in a product session.
Name the window. Panes inside it do not become extra tree rows.

window-names-the-parser-understands.text: Unknown names stay visible under unscoped. Nothing is dropped.
Milestone desks use m s, then a number, then a goal. Epics use e, tickets use t.
The word parked anywhere in the name marks the seat parked.

habits-that-make-the-browser-useful.text: Rename as soon as the lane has an id and a goal.
Keep one window per lane. Park by renaming, not by hoping the process list looks quiet.
